title: Queued promotion no longer advances the session mutation stamp, so a dispatched queued prompt can stay pending in SQLite and replay after a host exit
outcome: A promoted queued turn is always persisted (its row is re-stamped) before or with its dispatch, so a host exit cannot replay input already handed to the provider.
acceptance: The locked queued-promotion transaction in src/turn_dispatch.rs (start_turn_on_record and the queue/receipt updates after it) refreshes the session mutation stamp (as session_mut_by_index did) before composing its persistence delta.

A regression test covers the case where the background writer's watermark already consumed the row during the off-lock context preparation, and proves the promoted row and its receipt/transcript reach SQLite.

completion.summary: Queued promotion re-stamps the session before composing its persistence delta. Ordinary and receipted watermark regressions pass. Landed in eb78d349 with clean source pair and exact-tree FULL; independent evaluation1762dada passed both criteria.
